name: LeapPad Learning System
material: plastic; paper fiber product; metal; cardboard; electronic components
summary: The Leapfrog Learning System is a interactive educational device, which is similar to a talking book. It teaches reading, vocabulary, science and even foreign languages. It was hugely successful on release and the British Association of Toy Retailers awarded it Preschool Toy of the Year in 2001.
